title: Grading the trade: Jessie Bates gives Jaguars another playmaker, but value too good for Falcons to pass on

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Grading the trade: Jessie Bates gives Jaguars another playmaker, but value too good for Falcons to pass on
sources.description: The Jaguars had needs at other spots, but safety was a position they wanted to upgrade. For Atlanta, the return for Bates was too good to pass up.
